items.difficulty_reason: The proof displays the associativity identity (\mathcal{G} \otimes \mathcal{F}) \otimes \mathcal{H} = \mathcal{G} \otimes (\mathcal{F} \otimes \mathcal{H}) and observes that a composition of exact functors is exact: tensoring with \mathcal{G} (exact by flatness of \mathcal{G}) after tensoring with \mathcal{F} (exact by flatness of \mathcal{F}) is exact, so \mathcal{G} \otimes \mathcal{F} is flat. The displayed identity plus the composition principle is the complete derivation.
